clause_text: PLAYBOOK OF GOVERNMENT SCHEMES AND INITIATIVES FOR STARTUPS June 2026

While every effort  has been made to include a wide range of relevant initiatives, certain schemes, programmes, or opportunities may not have been  captured, may have undergone modifications, or may not be active or open for applications at a particular point in time. Several schemes  operate through specific application windows, calls for proposals, periodic notifications, or time-bound implementation cycles, which  may change from time to time. The information provided in this playbook is intended solely for general guidance and knowledge dissemination.

It presents a high-level  summary of schemes and initiatives and should not be construed as a substitute for the detailed guidelines, notifications, eligibility  conditions, or directions issued by the respective Ministry, Department, implementing agency, or other competent authority. Readers are encouraged to consult the official websites, notifications, and communications of the concerned Ministries, Departments,  and implementing agencies for the latest and most comprehensive information, including eligibility criteria, application processes,  timelines, and other operational details.

While reasonable care has been taken in compiling and presenting the information, the authors and publishers make no representation  regarding the completeness, accuracy, or continued availability of any scheme or programme. Any decisions, applications, or actions  taken based on the contents of this playbook should be undertaken after appropriate verification of the applicable scheme guidelines  and requirements.

PLAYBOOK OF GOVERNMENT SCHEMES AND INITIATIVES FOR STARTUPS Page 6 of 107 Objective This Playbook consolidates Central Government schemes and incentives  relevant to India’s startup ecosystem into a  single, usable reference document. It is  designed to help entrepreneurs find the right  scheme for their stage and sector. Who It Is For • Entrepreneurs & Founders • Students & Aspiring Entrepreneurs • Investors & Incubators • Policymakers & Intermediaries How to Use This Playbook 1 Start with the Decision Tree. Answer 5 quick questions to find schemes suited to you. 2 Check the “What Do You Need?” Index for a need-based view (grant, equity, loan, etc.).

3 Use the Lifecycle Map to find schemes matching your stage of growth. 4 Explore the Summary Table for a structured overview of all schemes with key details. 5 Deep dive into Scheme One-Pagers for full scheme details including how to apply. Focus Legend Startup Focus Legend ● Startup-Specific: Startups are the primary or sole eligible beneficiary explicitly named in  scheme eligibility. ● Startup-Relevant: Broader eligibility (MSMEs, companies, institutions) but startups regularly  benefit and apply.
